name: @malarstrom/gatewarden
description: Give a local development server an https address on your own domain: an MCP server, a pi extension, a CLI and an Agent Skill over one proxy-agnostic core

scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const args=process.argv.slice(1);const pattern=args.length===1&&args[0].includes('*')?args[0]:'';const slash=pattern.lastIndexOf('/'),star=pattern.indexOf('*');const dir=pattern.slice(0,slash),prefix=pattern.slice(slash+1,star),suffix=pattern.slice(star+1);const found=pattern&&fs.existsSync(dir)?fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((name)=>name.startsWith(prefix)&&name.endsWith(suffix)).sort():[];const files=pattern?found.map((name)=>dir+'/'+name):args;if(files.length===0){console.log('no test files: this is an installation, not a checkout');process.exit(0)}const env={...process.env};delete env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT;const hook=path.join(process.cwd(),'test/helpers/suite.ts');const runner=fs.existsSync(hook)?['--test','--import',hook,'--test-concurrency=1',...files]:['--test','--test-concurrency=1',...files];let status=spawnSync(process.execPath,runner,{stdio:'inherit',env}).status??1;const cleanup=path.join(process.cwd(),'test/helpers/cleanup.ts');if(fs.existsSync(cleanup)){const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,[cleanup],{stdio:'inherit',env});if(result.status!==0)status=1}process.exit(status)" test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),{pathToFileURL}=require('node:url');const file=process.argv[1];if(!fs.existsSync(file)){console.log('the end-to-end tools need a checkout of the repository: this is an installation, not a checkout');process.exit(0)}import(pathToFileURL(file).href).catch((error)=>{console.error(error);process.exit(1)})" tools/testenv/run.ts
